findings.current: The First Elder was a vile old monster who had lived more than sixty years with his black heart hidden.
findings.defect: The traditional duration 갑자 is flattened into ordinary years instead of using the established term.
findings.rationale: 갑자 is the traditional sixty-year cycle and is established as “jiazi” for this block.
findings.replacement: The First Elder was a vile old monster who had lived for more than one jiazi while concealing his black heart.
findings.source: 일장로는 일 갑자를 넘게 살아오며 흑심을 감춰 왔던 비열한 노괴(老怪)다.

findings.current: Sixty years. He had accumulated profound internal energy, but even that could not stop his body from aging.
findings.defect: The established traditional unit is again replaced by an ordinary year count.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly frames the passage in terms of one 갑자, not merely an approximate number of years.
findings.replacement: One jiazi. He had accumulated profound internal energy, but even that could not stop his body from aging.
findings.source: 일 갑자의 세월. 그는 심후한 공력을 얻었지만 육신의 노화까지는 어찌할 수 없었다.

findings.current: “As the Discipline Hall Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, I command you. The guilty shall abolish their own martial arts and enter the Cave of Repentance…”
findings.defect: The formal exalted family designation 대태원진가 is reduced to the ordinary family name, and 참회동 does not use its established English name.
findings.rationale: The source deliberately uses the exalted 대태원진가 in a formal judicial declaration, while 참회동 is established as “Repentance Cave.”
findings.replacement: “As the Discipline Hall Master of the great Jin Family of Taiyuan, I command you. The guilty shall abolish their own martial arts and enter the Repentance Cave…”
findings.source: 대태원진가의, 집법당주로서, 명한다. 죄인들은 스스로 무공을 전폐하고, 참회동에…….

findings.current: They were senior members of the so-called Elders’ faction.
findings.defect: The translation turns the named Council of Elders into a generic faction, obscuring the institutional affiliation.
findings.rationale: 장로원 is the established “Council of Elders,” and 계파 identifies these figures as its faction.
findings.replacement: They were senior members of the so-called Council of Elders faction.
findings.source: 소위 장로원 계파에 속하던 중진들이었다.

findings.current: “Squad Leeeader!”
findings.defect: Hyuk Mujin’s established form of address for Taekyung is replaced with a different rank.
findings.rationale: 조장 is established as “Captain” in this relationship and context.
findings.replacement: “Caaaptain!”
findings.source: “조자아앙!”

findings.current: A Skill that dumped several times my strength into a single blow—One Flash.
findings.defect: The named spear technique 일섬 is given the wrong established name.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is established as “One Annihilation”; the characters 一殲 specifically denote annihilation rather than a flash.
findings.replacement: A Skill that dumped several times my strength into a single blow—One Annihilation.
findings.source: 인벤토리를 활용한 공격과 순간적으로 몇 배의 힘을 일격에 쏟아붓는 스킬, 일섬(一殲).

findings.current: Sword Energy surged up, loaded with sixty years of internal energy.
findings.defect: The established traditional unit 갑자 is flattened into a year count.
findings.rationale: The source measures the Head Elder’s accumulated internal energy in one 갑자, established as “jiazi.”
findings.replacement: Sword Energy surged up, loaded with one jiazi of internal energy.
findings.source: 일 갑자의 공력을 머금은 검기가 치솟았다.

findings.current: “Naryeotagon? What a donkey of a man.”
findings.defect: The established martial-arts idiom is romanized incorrectly.
findings.rationale: 나려타곤 is established as “Narye tagon,” preserving both the named maneuver and the accompanying donkey joke.
findings.replacement: “Narye tagon? What a donkey of a man.”
findings.source: “나려타곤? 당나귀 같은 놈이구먼.”

findings.current: The sixty years of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian spread through every limb and bone.
findings.defect: The traditional unit 갑자 is replaced by an ordinary year count.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly quantifies his internal energy as one 갑자, established as “jiazi.”
findings.replacement: The one jiazi of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian spread through every limb and bone.
findings.source: 대장로의 단전에 웅크리고 있던 일 갑자의 공력이 전신 사지백해로 뻗어 나갔다.

findings.current: This, too, was an incomplete Hand Force, but it was enough to stop Jin Taekyung’s spear.
findings.defect: The martial-energy manifestation 수강 uses a non-established term.
findings.rationale: 수강 is established as “Palm Force,” distinct from Sword Force and generic Force.
findings.replacement: This, too, was an incomplete Palm Force, but it was enough to stop Jin Taekyung’s spear.
findings.source: 이 역시 불완전한 수강(手强)이었으나 진태경의 창을 멈춰 세우기에는 충분했다.

findings.current: “One Flash.”
findings.defect: Every occurrence of Taekyung’s named technique in this chapter uses the wrong established name.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is established as “One Annihilation,” and consistent naming matters throughout the technique’s explanation and repeated use.
findings.replacement: “One Annihilation.”
findings.source: “일섬.”

findings.current: “Then going straight into the Elder Council—was that why?”
findings.defect: The named governing body is rendered with a different English term.
findings.rationale: 장로원 is established as “Council of Elders.”
findings.replacement: “Then going straight into the Council of Elders—was that why?”
findings.source: “그렇다면 곧장 장로원에 들어간 것도?”

findings.current: “You should've struck a vital acupoint.”
findings.defect: The translation generalizes 사혈 and loses its explicitly lethal nature.
findings.rationale: 사혈 specifically means an acupoint whose strike can kill and is established as “lethal acupoint.”
findings.replacement: “You should've struck a lethal acupoint.”
findings.source: “사혈을 짚었어야지.”

findings.current: *One Flash.*
findings.defect: Taekyung’s named technique again uses the wrong established English name.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is established as “One Annihilation.”
findings.replacement: *One Annihilation.*
findings.source: ‘일섬.’

findings.current:
He was a sleeping dragon.

If he obtained the dragon pearl, he could roam the heavens.
findings.defect: The narration confuses the generic epithet 잠룡 with Taekyung’s separate title Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi and omits the established image of the azure heaven.
findings.rationale: Standalone 잠룡 is established as “Hidden Dragon,” while 창천 is “azure heaven”; the sentence deliberately develops the hidden-dragon and dragon-pearl metaphor.
findings.replacement:
He was a Hidden Dragon.

If he obtained the dragon pearl, he could roam the azure heaven.
findings.source: 그는 잠룡이다. 여의주를 얻으면 창천을 누빌 수 있는.

findings.current:
“The Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi…”

Wipeng gave a faint smirk.
findings.defect: The translation turns a brief amused exhalation into a smirk, adding a facial attitude not present in the source.
findings.rationale: 피식 웃었다 indicates a brief involuntary laugh or snort, not a sustained or contemptuous smirk.
findings.replacement:
“The Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi…”

Wipeng gave a quiet snort.
findings.source:
“산서잠룡이라.”

위팽은 피식 웃었다.

findings.current: The Sect Leader of Gunggwimun,[^1] Jin Chung, was one of them.
findings.defect: The sect’s established English name is replaced by an unestablished romanization.
findings.rationale: 궁귀문 is established as “Gunggui Sect.”
findings.replacement: The Sect Leader of the Gunggui Sect,[^1] Jin Chung, was one of them.
findings.source: 전투에 앞서 미리 절벽 위로 올라갔던 궁귀문(弓鬼門)의 문주, 진충이 바로 그런 경우였다.

findings.current: A gleaming silver tael had come flying from somewhere.
findings.defect: The currency unit 냥 is replaced with a different Chinese unit rather than the established rendering.
findings.rationale: 은자 is established as “silver nyang”; tael is not the designated unit for this translation.
findings.replacement: A gleaming silver nyang had come flying from somewhere.
findings.source: 번쩍거리는 은자 한 냥이 어디선가 날아온 것이다.

findings.current: A second silver tael landed perfectly in the storyteller’s bowl.
findings.defect: The second mention repeats the wrong currency unit.
findings.rationale: The established rendering of 은자 is “silver nyang.”
findings.replacement: A second silver nyang landed perfectly in the storyteller’s bowl.
findings.source: 두 번째 은자가 매담자의 대접에 정확히 안착했다.

findings.current: *The most handsome man of all time. A heaven-bestowed martial physique. A chivalrous hero who cannot stand injustice.*
findings.defect: The named constitution 천무지체 is paraphrased as a generic physique, losing an established Murim term.
findings.rationale: 천무지체 is the named “Heavenly Martial Physique”; the source presents it as one of the rumors attached to Taekyung.
findings.replacement: *The most handsome man of all time. Possessor of the heaven-bestowed Heavenly Martial Physique. A chivalrous hero who cannot stand injustice.*
findings.source: ‘고금 제일의 미남에. 하늘이 내린 천무지체. 불의를 보면 참지 못하는 협객.’

findings.current: I heard it from a gate guard of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.defect: The translation turns affiliation with the named Gate Guard Pavilion into the generic occupation “gate guard.”
findings.rationale: 수문각 is the established “Gate Guard Pavilion,” and 무사 identifies the source as one of its martial artists.
findings.replacement: I heard it from a martial artist of the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s Gate Guard Pavilion.
findings.source: 태원진가 수문각 무사한테 들은 거거든.

findings.current: - You have successfully completed **Qi Circulation**.
findings.defect: The translation invents a proper-name technique label instead of rendering the source action with the established verbal terminology.
findings.rationale: 운기조식 is established as the action “circulate one’s qi” and is better expressed as a verb here.
findings.replacement: - You have successfully circulated your qi.
findings.source: - [운기조식]을 성공적으로 마쳤습니다.

summary: The block is semantically strong overall, with no critical action or identity reversals. Actionable defects are concentrated in established Murim terminology, especially the named technique One Annihilation, several institutional and martial-energy terms, and a few glossary-defined units and epithets.
